parts.problem_md:
A triangle has sides 5 cm, 7 cm and 9 cm.

**Using a ruler and compasses only**, construct the triangle. 
The 5 cm line has been drawn for you. 
Show all your construction arcs.

![A single straight black line at the bottom of a blank white background.](assets/001-a-single-straight-black-line-at-the-bottom-of-a-.png)
parts.solution_md:
Draw an arc to mark the length of the 7 cm side

- Set your compass to a distance of 7 cm
- Put the sharp point of the compass on one end of the line

  - and draw an arc above the line

![Arc drawn, forming a curve above a horizontal line.](assets/002-arc-drawn-forming-a-curve-above-a-horizontal-lin.png)

> **[exam-tip]**
> You can draw the 7 cm arc from either end of the given line. Here it has been drawn coming from the left end of the line.

Draw an arc to mark the length of the 9 cm side

- Set your compass to a distance of 9 cm
- Put the sharp point of the compass on the other end of the line

  - and draw an arc above the line (make sure it crosses the first arc!)

![A geometric figure with two intersecting arcs above a horizontal line.](assets/003-a-geometric-figure-with-two-intersecting-arcs-ab.png)

The place where the two arcs intersect is the location where the other two sides of the triangle meet

- Mark the point
- Then use your ruler to draw the other two sides as straight lines

![Triangle whose base is a horizontal line. Its vertex is above the line, at the point where two arcs intersect.](assets/004-triangle-whose-base-is-a-horizontal-line-its-ver.png)

**[B1 B1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **B1**: For correct triangle.
> 
> **B1**: For correct construction arcs seen.

parts.problem_md:
The scale drawing shows the position of a boat, $B$.

The scale is 1 centimetre represents $40$  metres.

A lighthouse, $L$ is  $240$ metres from $B$, on a bearing of $135^{\circ}$.

On the scale drawing, mark the position of $L$.

![Map showing a vertical arrow labelled "North" pointing upwards from point B, with a scale of 1cm to 40m in the top left corner.](assets/005-map-showing-a-vertical-arrow-labelled-north-poin.png)
parts.solution_md:
Work out the length of the line

$240\div40=6$

Measure an angle of 135° clockwise from the North line

- Make sure the centre of your protractor is on *B*

Measure a 6 cm line from *B* in that direction

- Label the point *L*

![Diagram with points B and L connected by lines. B points north with a vertical line. Scale is 1cm equals 40m.](assets/006-diagram-with-points-b-and-l-connected-by-lines-b.png)

**[B1 B1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **B1**: For stating 6 cm or for a line of length between 5.9 cm and 6.1 cm.
> 
> **B1**: For drawing a line at an angle between 134° and 136°.
